subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
8.
What is the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) in kgs. for raw material 'OC'
required by Spice Guard Ltd. and number of orders to be placed in a year?
(A)  210 kgs. and 19 orders
(B)  250 kgs. and 16 orders
(C)  200 kgs. and 20 orders
(D)  400 kgs and 10 orders
(2 Marks)

4
